evals.prompt: Set up the iOS build so I can run the unit tests on this Mac.
evals.expectedBehavior: Locates Package.swift or the .xcodeproj/scheme and confirms a host-runnable test action exists (Logic loop).

evals.prompt: My test results look cached — clear DerivedData and clean the build.
evals.expectedBehavior: Removes stale DerivedData / runs xcodebuild clean or swift package clean so a red test is a real signal.

evals.prompt: Confirm swift test can run before we reproduce.
evals.expectedBehavior: Runs swift test --list-tests (or checks the scheme Test action) and confirms Logic FULL is honest on this macOS host.

evals.prompt: Boot a simulator and watch the SwiftUI screen render.
evals.expectedBehavior: Does not trigger — the device runtime is unwired (UI = ASSIST); this skill never observes a render.

evals.prompt: Write the failing test that reproduces the wrong total.
evals.expectedBehavior: Does not trigger — that is ios-reproduce, not environment.
